description:
Founding Full Stack Engineer (FinTech & EdTech)
 Location: San Francisco, CA (in person)
 Partnership: EQL Tech has been exclusively retained by a venture-backed startup building the financial infrastructure for the future of education. Families use it to access state education funds (Education Savings Accounts, or ESAs), part of the $900B US public education budget now being opened up so parents can direct their share, on average $7.5k per child per year. The product is live in Arizona, growing fast, and expanding to Florida and federal programs. The company has raised $16M from top-tier VCs and angels.
 The team
 A small, in-person team in San Francisco, most of them ex-founders. The founders are engineers who ran their own alternative school together: one was a quant at Goldman Sachs, the other built the computer vision system for the world's largest smart warehousing company at 19. The team includes people who led risk at Mercury, Stripe and Circle, built payments at Microsoft and Goldman Sachs, did AI research at MILA, and ran Arizona's ESA program.
 The role
 You will own the parent-facing experiences, mobile and web, end to end: receipts, claims, reimbursements and statements. Everything is designed for clarity and trust. A parent should never wonder whether a reimbursement will go through, whether something is eligible, or what to do next. There are two seats.
 End-to-end ownership: every screen and every interaction of the reimbursements product, from receipt capture and claims on mobile to statements on web.
 Built for trust: tie the interface tightly to backend and ops workflows so the payments machine is reliable and every action has a clean audit trail.
 Learn from real behaviour: instrument funnels and confusion hotspots, watch session recordings, and turn what you see into product changes.
 Set the standard: architecture, code quality and release process for the app layer, working closely with the engineer who owns the mobile app.
 Requirements 
 Your profile
 0 to 5 years of experience , obsessed with product and UX. A design or mobile background is a big plus.
 You ship constantly. Apps in production, including side projects you built just because you wanted them to exist.
 You care about the details. You notice the psychology of features, keep screenshots of clever flows, and enjoy watching PostHog recordings to spot surprising user behaviour.
 High agency. Nobody manages anyone on this team. You decide what matters and own it.
 AI native, not AI dependent. You use tools like Claude Code to move faster, and you still do your own thinking.
 The mission matters to you. No education background needed, but giving families real choice over their kids' education has to mean something to you.
 Happy to get out of localhost: visit families and work with state agencies.
 Able to work in person with the team in San Francisco . Visa sponsorship available.
 TypeScript, React and React Native are the house stack and a plus, not a filter.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 Salary: $125,000 to $200,000+, depending on experience.
 Meaningful founding equity. 
 Health: medical, dental and vision (up to 100% of premium for you and your dependents), life insurance, a health FSA and a 401(k).
 Visa sponsorship available.
 Impact: shape how the $900B US public education budget reaches families.
 How they hire
 An intro call with a founder, a technical deep dive with the CTO, an optional call with a parent, a take-home built from a real problem that you present on a whiteboard, then a short paid work trial in the office. Open books throughout: ask them anything.
